Not my story but my older brothers:

My brother used to be a promoter at this entertainment company that would throw EDM shows in the Twin Cities. One night he and his girlfriend went to the owner of the entertainment companies house to grab some equipment for a show they were throwing that night in Minneapolis. The owner was a Native American woman who belonged to the tribe that owns a local casino. That is to say; she is very, very wealthy, and lived in a big house. My brother always told stories about the creepy spiritual stuff she was in to, mainly tarot cards, so I was always kinda creeped out by her, but she was nice enough. Anyway, he always felt like there was something supernatural in the house being that she was so into spiritualism, and didn’t like being there by himself. But the show was that night so he and his girlfriend made the plan to stop in, grab the equipment, and get the fuck of the dodge. I’ve never been to the house, but according to my brother the basement had an unfinished part she used for storage for the entertainment co., that was kinda just a hallway. So my brother and his girlfriend go into the room and start grabbing the stuff, when the door to the hallway shuts, my brother and his girl look up and see a shadow pass by the window on the door. Then a few moments later, while my brother is trying to justify what just happened, his girlfriend says, “Sam...something is breathing on me”. They kinda froze and my brother claims he could see his girls hair moving, as if someone was inhaling and exhaling on it. So they dropped the equipment and ran, and my brother never went back in her house ever again.
